description: Source code for Odoo wiki module, defining classes for Wiki pages, groups, links, and history with associated methods.

classes.name: Wiki
classes.description: Represents a Wiki page with content, metadata, and revision history.

classes.name: WikiGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of Wiki pages with hierarchical structure and metadata.

classes.name: GroupLink
classes.description: Links between Wiki groups and menu actions.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Tracks revision history of Wiki pages, including diff generation.

methods.name: onchange_group_id
methods.description: Updates content and section based on selected group.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Wiki page and logs initial history if content provided.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates Wiki page and logs history if content changed.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Generates HTML diff between two revision histories.
